name: youtube_video_camoufox
description: YouTube watch page. Title/channel/published come from stable <meta>/JSON-LD; views/likes are parsed from the in-page ytInitialData/ytInitialPlayerResponse JSON (viewCount/likeCount) instead of the JS-rendered DOM. Uses prem_res_rotating; domcontentloaded avoids hanging on YouTube's constant polling. ENGINE: Camoufox, fingerprint_profile=windows_on_host — a Windows claim over this host's real AMD GPU vendor. Windows rather than the honest Linux because measurement put an honest Linux claim at 15 and 23 retries against 1 and 8 for Windows (see src/browser/fingerprint_profile.py). MEASURED 2026-08-27 (2 runs per engine, 4 runs in total on the one locale this preset has, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_27.json): all four runs across both engines returned the same payload field for field — title, channel, views 1808853690, likes 19353698, published_at 2009-10-24T23:57:33-07:00 — with no warnings on either. NO SEPARATION: neither variant is recommended over the other. No timing claim is made; the audit's elapsed times are 3s-quantized poll intervals and cannot rank engines. Four runs against one video is a thin basis for a durable statement either way. MEASURED 2026-08-28 (retest of the same twenty presets through the same harness after the five audit fixes; n=2 per locale, 92 runs, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_28.json): 2/2 runs returned data with title and channel filled, en-US on both -- identical to 08-27 and to the Chromium twin. Control preset: none of the five fixes touched it and nothing moved.
